channel.title: BusinessHub.cy — Cyprus Edition

item.title: Deputy Minister of Culture – Press conference

item.title: Commissioner for Administration and the Protection of Human Rights – Regional Conference

item.description: President Christodoulides represents Cyprus at COP31 in Antalya, focusing on regional climate resilience and international environmental policy alignment.

item.title: Keynote speech by the Shipping Deputy Minister of the Republic of Cyprus, Ms Marina Hadjimanolis, at the event entitled "Is maritime technology delivering..."
item.description: The Cyprus Shipping Deputy Ministry is prioritizing practical maritime technology delivery and a 'one-stop-shop' digital transformation to solidify the island's position as a global innovation hub.

item.title: Address by the Deputy Minister to the President of the Republic of Cyprus Irene Piki at the Plug and Play Cyprus Expo
item.description: Cyprus celebrates the first Plug and Play Expo, highlighting the nation's status as the EU's fastest-growing startup ecosystem and its push for international scalability.

item.title: Interior Minister – General Assembly of the "Nicosia – Capital of Cyprus" Initiative
item.description: Interior Minister Constantinos Ioannou addressed the General Assembly of the 'Nicosia – Capital of Cyprus' initiative, focusing on the city's strategic development and administrative role.

item.title: Deputy Minister to the President, Research Deputy Minister – Plug and Play Cyprus Expo 2026
item.description: High-level government representation at the Plug and Play Cyprus Expo 2026 signals continued state support for the island's burgeoning startup and fintech ecosystem.

item.title: State Employees by Category: October 2026
item.description: Cyprus state employment rose 0.6% to 55,317 in October 2026, driven by permanent staff and security forces, while short-term contracts saw a sharp decline.

item.description: Cyprus' Chief Scientist engaged in high-level UNESCO dialogues on science diplomacy and the transformative convergence of AI and quantum computing.

item.title: Agriculture Minister – 4th Pancyprian Conference “Rural Development – From Research to Practice”
item.description: The 4th Pancyprian Conference on Rural Development focused on bridging the gap between scientific research and practical agricultural applications to modernize the Cypriot primary sector.

item.description: Deputy Minister Irene Piki met with Australian High Commissioner Emily Louise Pugin to discuss strengthening bilateral relations and diplomatic cooperation between Cyprus and Australia.

item.title: EU-Ukraine Drone Alliance Board meets to accelerate development and production of drone and counter-drone systems
